# The short payment again, this time naming the parked split outright.
#
# The block says 100.00 arrived; the bank received 60.00. Written with
# `txn_guid:` alone that is refused — the invoice would be left part-paid out
# of money the file does not describe. Naming the split has to earn the same
# refusal, because naming a split says *which* split settles the invoice and
# says nothing about how much arrived.
#
# Measured before that: it was accepted, and the invoice settled by 60 while
# the file asserted 100. Exit 0, no note.
#
# What this fixture produces: the same refusal `txn_guid:` alone earns.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-03
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "293a4b5c6d7e8f900112233445566778"
    txn_split_guid: "4b5c6d7e8f9001122334455667788a9b"
